continuity: The Heavenly Power Demon has been imprisoned by the Sichuan Tang Clan for more than forty years; his dantian is ruined, his limb sinews are severed, and he knows little about the current Murim.
The Heavenly Power Demon was once an Elder and commander of the Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult who led the subjugation of Qinghai and opened the first front of its holy war.
The Heavenly Power Demon says the Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult survived the Great Faction War in a greatly diminished state and was driven into the Tianshan Mountains.
The Heavenly Power Demon says the Cult Leader eventually abandoned his original beliefs and became corrupt, while neither the Divine Cult nor the orthodox Murim was inherently free of cruelty.
The Yin-Yang Twin Ghosts were once accepted by the Divine Cult but later served Dark Heaven; their appearance at Shaolin was not an act of the Demonic Cult.
plot: Jin Taekyung learns that the Heavenly Power Demon was once an Elder of the Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult who led the subjugation of Qinghai and opened the first front of its holy war. The old prisoner explains that the Great Faction War was morally complex, that the Divine Cult survived in a diminished state in the Tianshan Mountains, and that its former Cult Leader eventually became corrupt. Taekyung reveals that the Yin-Yang Twin Ghosts later served Dark Heaven rather than the Demonic Cult's attack on Shaolin, but Cheongpung arrives before he can finish explaining.
translation_decisions: Render 대천마신교 as Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult, distinct from 천마신교 as Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.
Render 신교 and 본교 contextually as Divine Cult when referring to the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult from its own side.
Render 음양쌍귀 as Yin-Yang Twin Ghosts and 양귀 as Yang Ghost, distinct from 음양쌍괴 as Yin-Yang Twin Freaks.
Retain the Heavenly Power Demon's gruff, formal self-reference as this old man.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung possesses the Myriad-Poison Ring, but Item Appraisal says a special condition is required to appraise it.

The Divine Physician and Mungyeong are on the fourth day of a fifteen-day treatment of Jeok Cheongang using the ring and Cold-Ice Stone in the deepest underground prison cell of the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison, and Jin Taekyung recognizes him as his Master while guarding him.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord is a one-armed middle-aged martial artist who killed the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord commands hundreds of black-robed hunters summoned through a concealed Mystic Gate Formation and intends to hunt Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan.
The Qilian Three Fiends from the Qilian Mountains have submitted to the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
The Heavenly Power Demon is imprisoned in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison with severed limb sinews, a ruined dantian, and heavy restraints after more than forty years of captivity.
The Heavenly Power Demon was once an Elder and commander of the Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult who led the subjugation of Qinghai and opened the first front of its holy war.
The Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult survived the Great Faction War in a diminished state and was driven into the Tianshan Mountains; the Yin-Yang Twin Ghosts later served Dark Heaven.
The Heavenly Power Demon says the Divine Cult's former Cult Leader became corrupt and that the Great Faction War cannot be reduced to a simple division between righteous and evil sides.
open_questions: Will the Divine Physician's fifteen-day treatment save Jeok Cheongang?
What special condition is required to appraise the Myriad-Poison Ring?
Can Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan withstand the Western Heaven Demon Lord's planned hunt?
What is the identity and purpose of the Lord of Heaven invoked by the Western Heaven Demon Lord?
Will Venerable Myoryeong fully recover from the Black Hand Seal?
temporary_decisions: Render 서천마군 as Western Heaven Demon Lord.
Render 대천마신교 as Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult and 천마신교, 신교, and 본교 as Heavenly Demon Divine Cult or Divine Cult according to context.
Render 음양쌍귀 as Yin-Yang Twin Ghosts and 양귀 as Yang Ghost.

names.notes: Formal historical name used by the Heavenly Power Demon for the Demonic Cult.
Short form used by the Divine Cult's members for the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.
Self-referential form meaning the speaker's own Divine Cult.
Source spelling for the pair otherwise associated with the Yin Ghost and Yang Ghost.
Shortened counterpart to the established Yin Ghost.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** An elderly prisoner in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison whose limb sinews were severed and whose restraints are heavier than those of the other prisoners.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Former Elder of the Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult who led the subjugation of Qinghai and opened the first front of its holy war, now an elderly prisoner in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison with severed limb sinews and a ruined dantian.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Quiet and self-possessed despite his severe imprisonment.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** Quiet and self-possessed despite his severe imprisonment, he is reflective about the moral ambiguity of the Great Faction War and disillusioned with the Divine Cult's corruption.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** He is one of the notorious martial criminals imprisoned by the Sichuan Tang Clan and is the man who urinated on the Kunlun Sect's signboard.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** He was once an Elder and commander under the Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult's Cult Leader, has spent more than forty years imprisoned by the Sichuan Tang Clan, and is known for urinating on the Kunlun Sect's signboard.
